links.comparator_used: Baseline prompt without entry-to-care instruction (open-ended chatbot behavior)
links.outcome: Self-care/home-management advice before any patient answer; structured handoff summary produced
links.effect: Self-care advice before any patient answer in 9/12 baseline case-model cells vs 0/12 instruction cells; structured handoff summaries in 0/12 baseline vs 10/12 instruction cells
links.tradeoff: The instruction did not reliably ensure elicitation of decisive facts.
links.quote: Self-care or home-management advice before any patient answer appeared in 9 of 12 baseline case-model cells and 0 of 12 instruction cells, while structured handoff summaries appeared in 0 of 12 and 10 of 12 cells, respectively.
